title: Observability Engineer (Datadog)
description:
Position: Observability Engineer (Datadog) 
 Experience: 5+ Years Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Coimbatore, Pune, and Noida Job Type: Permanent Notice Period: Immediate 
 Job Description We are seeking an Observability Engineer to drive the implementation, management, and optimization of monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with modern observability tools and a strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud environments, and incident management. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain observability solutions using tools such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK/Elastic Stack, Prometheus, and Grafana. Develop and optimize dashboards, alerts, and reports to provide actionable insights into system health and performance. Aggregate, parse, and analyze logs and metrics from various sources. Collaborate with development, operations, and support teams to define monitoring requirements and improve system reliability. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to monitoring, logging, and alerting. Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews. Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in observability and monitoring. Required Skills Hands-on experience with one or more observability platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, or Grafana. Strong understanding of monitoring, logging, and alerting best practices. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and their monitoring services. Experience with Application Performance Monitoring (APM) tools. Knowledge of distributed systems and microservices architecture. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Scripting or programming experience in Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Familiarity with ITSM/ITIL processes. Experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools. Experience in automating observability processes and integrating them with CI/CD pipelines.

Key Skills: Distribution,Microsoft Azure,Continuous Integration,Cloud,AWS,Incident management,Continuous Integration,Splunk
